Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Project Description
 Join our Bucharest Development Centre and work with a global financial services client on a high-performance securitization platform .
 You will be part of an international engineering team building scalable and secure financial technology solutions using Java, Spring Boot, microservices, PostgreSQL, messaging systems, Kubernetes and GCP .
 This is a great opportunity to work on complex financial systems, collaborate with experienced engineers and architects, and grow your technical expertise in a global environment.
 Work model: Hybrid – 3 days per week on-site in Bucharest 
 Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain high-quality Java applications within a microservices architecture.
Build scalable backend services using Java and Spring Boot .
Design and optimize PostgreSQL databases , including schemas, queries, and indexes.
Develop message-driven and event-based applications using Pub/Sub technologies.
Participate in the full software development lifecycle , from requirements to production.
Write clean, maintainable, and testable code following SOLID and software craftsmanship principles .
Develop and maintain unit and integration tests , applying TDD/BDD practices where appropriate.
Collaborate with Business Analysts, QAs, Architects, Product Owners, and other engineering teams .
Contribute to architectural decisions and the evolution of the platform.
Work in an Agile/Scrum environment within globally distributed teams.
Ensure solutions are reliable, scalable, and easy to support in production.
 Skills
 Must Have 
 Java 21+: Strong hands-on experience with modern Java.
 Spring Boot: Solid experience with Spring Boot 3.x, Spring MVC, and Spring Data .
 Microservices: Proven experience designing and developing scalable microservices architectures .
 PostgreSQL: Strong knowledge of database design, query optimization, and indexing .
 Messaging: Experience with event-driven architecture and messaging platforms such as Google Cloud Pub/Sub, Kafka, or RabbitMQ .
 Software Engineering: Strong knowledge of SOLID, clean code, design principles, and automated testing (JUnit/Mockito).
 Cloud & Containers: Experience with GCP, Kubernetes, and Helm .
 CI/CD & Tools: Experience with Maven, Git, Jenkins and/or TeamCity .
 Testing: Hands-on experience with TDD and/or BDD .
 Agile: Experience working with Scrum/Agile methodologies , Jira and Confluence.
 English: C1 – Advanced.
 Nice to Have 
 Google Cloud Platform: Hands-on experience with GKE, Cloud SQL, BigQuery , or other GCP services.
Experience with additional cloud-native technologies and distributed systems.
 Seniority
 Senior 
 Location
 Bucharest, Romania – Hybrid 
 This role requires 3 days per week on-site at the client’s office.
 Compensation 
 We are currently hiring for multiple roles requiring similar skill sets , with different salary budgets depending on the position and level of experience. We kindly ask you to share your salary expectations , so we can assess your profile, skills, and expectations and identify the opportunities that best match your background and requirements.
